summary: Learn to build, test, and roll out custom GPTs and AI assistants with practical templates, governance, and hands-on workshops.
lede: Building Custom GPTs and AI Assistants for Business Teams teaches you how to turn a defined business use case into a practical, task-specific assistant. You will learn to write precise instructions, organize knowledge files, structure content for retrieval, create output templates, and add guardrails for more consistent results. The course focuses on applied delivery, from scoping and conversation design to benchmark testing, evaluation scenarios, and launch readiness review. You will also prepare a controlled first version and a realistic adoption plan for service desks, internal advisory workflows, and team knowledge hubs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to shape custom GPTs and AI assistants into usable business tools, not experimental chat demos.
prerequisites: Participants should have working familiarity with business processes, internal documentation, and everyday use of generative AI tools. No coding is required for completion, although comfort with structured documents, spreadsheets, and workflow tools will help. The advanced concepts in this course are taught at an operational application level, with hands-on practice in prompt design, knowledge structuring, testing, and rollout planning rather than software engineering or API development.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
